subject.title: [Bug]: QA Docker proofs do not execute documented artifacts

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101045 as the canonical fix for this Docker QA proof gap once PR review remains clean?
rationale: The issue is member-authored, protected by the `maintainer` label, and already has an open closing PR with exact-head Docker proof, so cleanup automation should not close it or start a competing repair branch.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Use the linked PR as the fix path and close this issue only after that PR merges or is deliberately resolved.

options.title: Request changes on the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers ask for narrower Docker proof, additional CI evidence, or implementation changes on the existing PR.

options.title: Reject this proof direction
options.body: Keep or close the linked PR based on a maintainer decision that these Docker artifact proofs should not be part of QA Lab core evidence.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the fix path and close this issue only after that PR merges or is deliberately resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: `RomneyDa` owns the recent QA scenario descriptor history and the linked fix PR for this exact issue.
